description: Presidential Secretariate - The Commission of Inquiry enlarge once again the Period of time up to 3rd September 2023
categorisation: This gazette content concerns the extension of a deadline for a Commission of Inquiry to render its final report, which is done under the authority of the Commission of Inquiry Act. This is a legal/regulatory matter involving the modification of a statutory timeline for a legal process, fitting the definition of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes). While it names the President, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities or make a personnel change, so it does not qualify for a government-related classification (Types 1-3).
